scenes.text: You are looking at the quietest place on Earth, a highly specialized room so incredibly silent that no human can stand to stay inside it for more than forty five minutes.
When you step into this ultra silent chamber, the absolute lack of external noise forces your own body to become a loud orchestra as you hear your internal organs functioning.
Within minutes of entering, you will start loudly hearing your own lungs gasping, the rushing of blood pumping through your veins, and even your neck bones grinding together.
This terrifying sensory deprivation eventually forces your brain to hallucinate loud noises just to fill the void, so would you dare to spend an hour here? Comment below and follow for more!
